# `<ptfkit/tiwary2014.h>`

```c
#include <ptfkit/tiwary2014.h>
```

Tiwary et al. (2014), hydraulic PTFs for two major soil regions of India.

## Source

Tiwary, P., Patil, N. G., Bhattacharyya, T., Chandran, P., Ray, S. K., Karthikeyan, K., ... & Thakre, S. (2014). Pedotransfer functions: a tool for estimating hydraulic properties of two major soil types of India. Current Science, 1431-1439.

## Scope

**Territory:** Indo-Gangetic Plains and black soil region of India

**Dataset:** 209 layers from 30 Indo-Gangetic Plains profiles and 275 layers from 62 black-soil profiles; equation-specific subsets are described below.

[PTF catalog page](../../../ptf-catalog/sources/tiwary2014.md)

## `tiwary2014_ptf_result`

```c
typedef struct {
    double w_33;
    double w_100;
    double w_1500;
    double k_sat;
 } tiwary2014_ptf_result;
```

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `w_33` | Gravimetric water content at 33 kPa. (%) |
| `w_100` | Gravimetric water content at 100 kPa. (%) |
| `w_1500` | Gravimetric water content at 1500 kPa. (%) |
| `k_sat` | Saturated hydraulic conductivity converted from mm/h. (m/s) |

## Functions

### `calc_ptf_tiwary2014_igp` {#function-calc_ptf_tiwary2014_igp}

Estimate saturated conductivity for Indo-Gangetic Plains soils.

```c
static inline double calc_ptf_tiwary2014_igp(double sand, double bulk_density, double esp);
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sand` | in | Sand content. (%) |
| `bulk_density` | in | Bulk density. (Mg/m^3) |
| `esp` | in | Exchangeable sodium percentage. (%) |

#### Returns

Saturated hydraulic conductivity converted from mm/h. (m/s)

!!! note

    Equation 11 was calibrated on 100 layers from 20 Indo-Gangetic Plains profiles.

!!! warning

    The legacy API's three water-retention outputs are intentionally excluded because the source defines them only for BSR soils.

### `calc_ptf_tiwary2014_bsr` {#function-calc_ptf_tiwary2014_bsr}

Estimate water retention and saturated conductivity for the black soil region.

```c
static inline tiwary2014_ptf_result calc_ptf_tiwary2014_bsr(double clay, double ph, double cation_exchange_capacity, double esp, double emp, double excm);
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `clay` | in | Clay content. (%) |
| `ph` | in | Soil pH. (dimensionless) |
| `cation_exchange_capacity` | in | Cation exchange capacity. (cmol(c)/kg) |
| `esp` | in | Exchangeable sodium percentage. (%) |
| `emp` | in | Exchangeable magnesium percentage. (%) |
| `excm` | in | Exchangeable calcium-to-magnesium ratio. (dimensionless) |

#### Returns

A `tiwary2014_ptf_result` value.

!!! note

    Water-retention equations used 75 layers from 14 profiles; equation 10 used 200 layers from 46 profiles.
